_meta.description: 按认证类目筛选商家并统计GMV

workflow.name: 按认证类目统计商家GMV
workflow.description: 根据需求方提供的认证类目(cert_category)筛选已付费商家，统计其GMV/PMV数据

input.cert_category_list: 需求方提供的认证类目列表（枚举值太多，由需求方给出）

output.final_table: 最终结果表，包含店铺ID、名称、GMV、PMV等

steps.name: 筛选类目商家
steps.description: 从已付费商家表中按cert_category筛选商家
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT user_no, subject_cert_type_name, cert_subject_name,
       cert_category, cert_qualificatio_name,
       kdt_id, team_name, product, open_status, service_staff_name
FROM {source_table}
WHERE cert_category IN ({category_list})

steps.name: 统计GMV/PMV
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT payee_id,
       SUM(gmv_amount) AS amount,
       SUM(gmv_num) AS gmv_num,
       SUM(pmv_amount) AS pmv,
       SUM(pmv_num) AS pmv_num
FROM {source_table}
WHERE pay_day >= '{start_date}' AND pay_day < '{end_date}'
GROUP BY payee_id

steps.name: 关联结果
steps.description: 通过 user_no = payee_id 关联商家信息和GMV数据
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT a.*,
       b.amount AS gmv,
       b.gmv_num,
       b.pmv,
       b.pmv_num
FROM {step1_table} a
LEFT JOIN {step2_table} b ON a.user_no = b.payee_id

key_concepts.已付费商家: dev.union_paid_shop_cert_info表中的商家都是已付费商家
key_concepts.cert_category: 认证类目，枚举值由需求方提供
key_concepts.user_no关联: user_no(有赞商户号) 可直接与 payee_id(收款方ID) 关联
key_concepts.payee_id: 收款方ID，对应user_no有赞商户号

relationship_note.user_no vs kdt_id: user_no是有赞商户号，kdt_id是店铺ID，类似驾照号vs身份证号。在这个case中用user_no关联payee_id，如果需要用kdt_id，需通过ods.pay_funds_user中间表转换
